newsitem.title: USA: Valspar to form joint venture in Brazil.
newsitem.headline: Valspar to form joint venture in Brazil.

text.p: Valspar Corp said Tuesday it and Renner Herrmann S.A. will form a joint venture in Brazil for the manufacture and sale of packaging coatings in South America.
Renner Herrmann, based in Brazil, produces coatings for the consumer, automotive, industrial, wood, and packaging coatings markets. It has sales of more than $600 million.
Sales of the joint venture are expected to exceed $10 million in the first year of operation. Valspar and Renner Herrmann will each own 50 percent of the new company.
The joint venture is expected to be operational in June under the name Valspar Renner Packaging Coatings Ltda.

"This transaction is another step in our strategy to supply our global Packaging Coatings customers with product anywhere they have facilities," said Richard Rompala, Valspar president and chief executive officer. "In combination with recent acquisitions in Europe, Asia, and Australia, this joint venture provides us with the infrastructure to become a truly global player in the coatings market."
Shares of Valspar were trading off 1/8 to 28-1/8.
